name: How to Search for Jobs While Studying in Canada
description: I graduated from McGill University in May 2022 with a Bachelor of Arts degree in Economics and minors in Management and International Development Studies. In the summer of my third year at university, I had an internship at one of the largest banks in Canada and continued my work there part-time during my final year of studies. Currently, I am a Consultant at a Big 4 Consulting Firm in Toronto, ON.
